_comment: Inventory of the cross-tenant attack attempts the gate runs. The gate uses backend/tests/redteam/cross_tenant_demo.py::run_all() as the source of truth; this file documents the EXPECTED-fail attempts so a contributor who removes one (or adds a new one without wiring it in) is visible in code review.

attempts.name: forged_token_chat
attempts.describe: POST /api/v1/widget/chat with HS256 token signed by a forged key → must 401

attempts.name: body_tenant_id_injection
attempts.describe: POST /api/v1/widget/chat with valid Tenant A token AND body tenant_id=Tenant B → must be served strictly under Tenant A (body field ignored)
